H01: Exact selected revisions publish atomically, snapshot inputs and remain pinned after later edits.
H02: Visibility filters reads; publication snapshots are immutable and policy updates compare versions and owners.
H03: Fork commit atomically rechecks source revision, current policy and target ownership, rolling back on rejection.
H04: Published descendants inherit current ancestor visibility and fork restrictions; private workspace copies remain owned.
H05: Original-root pagination includes visible revisions and branches, excludes unrelated/hidden rows before limiting, and never returns hidden-row cursors.
